title: Marginal-Preserving Coupled Diffusion Composition for Long-Horizon Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.15585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compositional diffusion planners extend short-horizon trajectory models to long-horizon goal-conditioned planning by generating and stitching multiple local trajectory chunks. However, in multimodal environments, local plausibility is not sufficient for global consistency: independently initialized chunks may denoise toward incompatible overlap modes, producing plans that are individually feasible but incoherent after stitching. Existing remedies typically add search, guidance, pruning, or graph-based structure at inference time, increasing computational cost or relying on task-specific machinery. We instead investigate graph-structured dependence among chunk-wise initial diffusion noises as a lightweight coordination mechanism for compositional trajectory planning. translated_title: 面向长时程规划的边缘保持耦合扩散组合
translated_abstract: 组合式扩散规划器通过生成并拼接多个局部轨迹片段，将短时程轨迹模型扩展到长时程目标条件规划。然而，在多模态环境中，局部合理性并不足以保证全局一致性：独立初始化的片段可能在去噪过程中趋向于互不兼容的重叠模式，导致生成的规划虽然各自可行，但拼接后却不连贯。现有的补救方法通常在推理阶段引入搜索、引导、剪枝或基于图的结构，这会增加计算成本或依赖任务特定的机制。我们转而研究各片段初始扩散噪声之间的图结构依赖关系，将其作为一种轻量级的协调机制用于组合式轨迹规划。我们提出了边缘保持耦合扩散组合（MCDC），这是一种面向预训练组合式扩散模型的无需训练的推理方法……
tldr: 提出无需训练的MCDC方法，通过在各轨迹片段的初始扩散噪声之间建立图结构依赖这一轻量级协调机制，解决组合式扩散规划中局部片段拼接后全局不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: MCDC is a training-free inference method that coordinates chunk-wise initial diffusion noises via graph-structured dependence, resolving the global inconsistency that arises when stitching independently denoised local trajectory chunks in compositional long-horizon planning.
